2. It has been submitted by Mr. Syed Ziaul Karim the learned Advocate for the petitioner that the petitioner is an Ex-project Implementation Officer, Shariatpur and was a Class II Gazetted Officer and sanction was obtained from Mr. Md. Abu Thaher Khan, Director of President's Secretariate by order of the President on 28.6.93 but by amendment of the Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 coming into effect on 23rd November, 1992 sanction in respect of a Class II Government Officer, below the scale of Taka 6300-8050/sanction should be obtained from the Principal Secretary, Prime Minister's Office. The learned Advocate has submitted that the petitioner cannot be proceeded against in the special case without a sanction from proper authority. In view of the amendment of Criminal Law Amendment Act 1958, in respect of sanction for prosecution Schedule to Rule 3, sanction in respect of the present petitioner appears to be obtainable from the Principal Secretary, Prime Minister's office, not from the President's Secretariate. 

 3. Mr. Syed Matiul Islam the learned Assistant Attorney-General concedes that the application may be summarily allowed by way of direction to the Special Tribunal for obtaining fresh sanction from the Principal Secretary, Prime Minister's Office for trial of the petitioner. After obtaining such sanction under section 6(5) of the Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 the Special Tribunal will frame fresh charge against the petitioner and proceed with the trial. With these observations this application is summarily allowed.
